headline: VMS TMT submits SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for Q2 2026
summary: VMS TMT has submitted its compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. This routine regulatory filing confirms the dematerialisation and rematerialisation of share certificates during the quarter. The filing is a standard corporate governance requirement for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no direct financial impact from this procedural update.
why_it_matters: No direct financial consequence for shareholders.

headline: VMS TMT submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine procedural filing from VMS TMT
summary: VMS TMT Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a standard compliance filing required after the conclusion of a company's AGM. For an Indian retail investor, this carries no financial impact as it is routine administrative disclosure.
why_it_matters: No financial impact from standard compliance paperwork.
